events.title: Inflection Point Acquisition V (IPEX) hit by heavy redemptions and going concern risk
events.summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V (IPEX), a SPAC, faces substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern following significant redemptions. As of June 30, 2026, the company reported a working capital deficit of $2.76 million and minimal cash outside its trust account. Following shareholder approval for an extension on August 12, 2026, over 7.4 million public shares were redeemed for approximately $79.1 million, leaving only $12.2 million in the Trust Account and potentially jeopardizing its proposed business combination with GOWell Technology Limited.

articles.headline: Inflection Point Acquisition V (IPEX) hit by heavy redemptions and going concern risk

events.title: Jumia Technologies AG (JMIA) director acquires 905,797 ADS in $5.52 private deal
events.summary: Jumia Technologies AG director Hassanein Shahreza Hiridjee, through Yas Holding Ltd, purchased 905,797 American Depositary Shares (ADS) in a private placement from the company on August 12, 2026, at $5.52 per ADS. This transaction increased indirect holdings via Yas Holding Ltd to 13,119,635 ADS, with each ADS representing two ordinary shares. The acquisition was executed under a Share Purchase Agreement, and the Form 4 filing details the insider trade.

articles.headline: Jumia Technologies AG (JMIA) director acquires 905,797 ADS in $5.52 private deal

events.title: Seagate Stock Surges As Earnings Beat Triggers Big Target Hikes
events.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings PLC (NASDAQ: STX) saw its stock surge by 5.65% after reporting strong FY26 earnings, including a 34% revenue increase to $12.2 billion and record free cash flow of $3.1 billion. The company's performance, driven by cloud data center demand and its Mozaic/HAMR platform tied to AI data growth, led major banks to raise price targets and reaffirm bullish ratings. Analysts highlighted accelerating HAMR adoption, robust Nearline exabyte growth, and improved HDD pricing as key factors for higher margins and EPS growth.

articles.headline: Seagate Stock Surges As Earnings Beat Triggers Big Target Hikes

events.title: ConocoPhillips reaches $5 billion divestiture target early after completing $1.7 billion noncore asset sale
events.summary: ConocoPhillips has exceeded its $5 billion divestiture target ahead of schedule, driven by a recent $1.7 billion sale of noncore Lower 48 assets. This strategic move aligns with a broader industry trend among U.S. shale producers to streamline portfolios, focus on higher-return assets, and prioritize value over volume. The company also announced better-than-expected second-quarter profits and a leadership change, with Andy O’Brien named Chief Financial Officer.

articles.headline: ConocoPhillips reaches $5 billion divestiture target early after completing $1.7 billion noncore asset sale

events.title: Empery Digital (EMPD) insider group acquires 1.4M shares across two August trades
events.summary: Empery Asset Management and affiliated entities, a ten percent owner of Empery Digital Inc. (EMPD), acquired a total of 1.4 million shares of common stock in two separate open-market transactions in August 2026. These purchases, totaling over $4 million, increased their holdings to 4,330,345 shares through affiliated funds, with Ryan M. Lane directly holding an additional 100,000 shares. The transactions indicate a positive sentiment from this insider group towards Empery Digital.

articles.headline: Empery Digital (EMPD) insider group acquires 1.4M shares across two August trades

events.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise's settlement regarding $14B Juniper acquisition approved
events.summary: A settlement concerning Hewlett Packard Enterprise's $14 billion acquisition of Juniper has been approved, despite concerns about the deal reducing competition in enterprise wireless networking. The ruling determined that the settlement is in the public interest. This development follows previous scrutiny and a government shutdown that stalled the antitrust case.

articles.headline: Hewlett Packard Enterprise's settlement regarding $14B Juniper acquisition approved

events.title: Peabody Energy, Borr Drilling, Texas Pacific Land, Halliburton, and Transocean Stocks Trade Up, What You Need To Know
events.summary: Stocks of several energy companies, including Peabody Energy, Borr Drilling, Texas Pacific Land, Halliburton, and Transocean, rose following a surge in crude oil prices. This increase was driven by escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and ongoing supply concerns, pushing WTI crude above $81 and Brent crude near $90. The market's focus on these geopolitical risks outweighed a significant weekly build in U.S. commercial crude stocks, impacting energy market volatility.

events.title: Phillips 66 (PSX) and Marathon Petroleum (MPC) reportedly held merger talks earlier this year in a deal that would have created a USD 180bln oil-and-gas giant, according to Semafor citing sources
events.summary: Phillips 66 (PSX) and Marathon Petroleum (MPC) reportedly engaged in merger discussions earlier this year, aiming to create a $180 billion oil-and-gas conglomerate. Although the talks did not result in a deal, they highlight the industry's trend towards consolidation as a response to challenging downstream market conditions. Such a merger would have concentrated a significant portion of US refining capacity, likely triggering substantial antitrust scrutiny and potential divestitures.

articles.headline: Phillips 66 (PSX) and Marathon Petroleum (MPC) reportedly held merger talks earlier this year in a deal that would have created a USD 180bln oil-and-gas giant, according to Semafor citing sources

events.title: Newmont Corporation Stock (NEM) Moved Up by 3.20% on Aug 14: What Signal Does It Send?
events.summary: Newmont Corporation (NEM) stock rose 3.20% on August 14, driven by a strong precious metals market due to easing inflation fears and a significant settlement with Barrick Mining. The company's stock also benefited from robust quarterly financial performance, including record free cash flow despite lower output, and positive analyst sentiment. Technical indicators show a buy signal, though some overbought conditions are noted.

articles.headline: Newmont Corporation Stock (NEM) Moved Up by 3.20% on Aug 14: What Signal Does It Send?

events.title: Alumis (NASDAQ:ALMS) Shares Gap Down After Earnings Miss
events.summary: Alumis Inc. (NASDAQ:ALMS) experienced a significant share price drop after reporting disappointing earnings, missing both revenue and EPS consensus estimates. Despite the poor financial results and insider selling, analyst sentiment remains largely positive with a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating and a target price of $40.30. Several institutional investors, including BlackRock and Spruce Street Capital, recently established new positions in the company, while insiders sold a notable number of shares.

articles.headline: Alumis (NASDAQ:ALMS) Shares Gap Down After Earnings Miss

events.title: FOX (NASDAQ:FOXA) Raised to "Overweight" at JPMorgan Chase & Co.
events.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. upgraded FOX (NASDAQ:FOXA) from a "neutral" to an "overweight" rating, setting an $82 price target, indicating a potential 25.29% upside. This upgrade follows FOX's strong quarterly earnings, where it reported $1.79 EPS against an estimated $1.44, and a 28.1% year-over-year revenue increase to $4.21 billion. Despite the upgrade, analyst sentiment for FOX remains mixed, with a consensus "hold" rating and an average price target of $74.31.

articles.headline: FOX (NASDAQ:FOXA) Raised to "Overweight" at JPMorgan Chase & Co.

events.title: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals merger with Vertex Pharmaceuticals advances after regulatory clearances
events.summary: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals announced that its proposed merger with Vertex Pharmaceuticals is progressing after receiving regulatory approvals and the expiration of antitrust waiting periods in several jurisdictions. The merger, valuing Crinetics at approximately $10 billion, is expected to close in early September 2026, pending Crinetics shareholder approval. Despite recent downgrades from analysts following the acquisition announcement, Crinetics shares are trading near their 52-week high, reflecting strong investor confidence in the deal.

articles.headline: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals merger with Vertex Pharmaceuticals advances after regulatory clearances
Crinetics Pharmaceuticals merger with Vertex Pharmaceuticals advances after regulatory clearances

events.title: Expand Energy agrees to acquire Twin Eagle in a $1.25 billion deal to strengthen its U.S. natural gas platform
events.summary: Expand Energy is set to acquire Twin Eagle Holdings, N.A., LLC for $1.25 billion to enhance its U.S. natural gas platform. This acquisition will integrate Expand Energy's supply and financial strength with Twin Eagle's marketing platform, creating a fully integrated natural gas company. The deal is expected to close in the third quarter of 2026, positioning Expand Energy as a leading integrated natural gas company and marketer in North America.

articles.headline: Expand Energy agrees to acquire Twin Eagle in a $1.25 billion deal to strengthen its U.S. natural gas platform

events.title: Atika Capital (JATT) discloses 5.1% beneficial stake in JATT II Acquisition Corp.
events.summary: Atika Capital Management LLC and Brad Farber have reported a beneficial ownership of 5.1% in JATT II Acquisition Corp., totaling 400,000 ordinary shares. This stake is held through advisory clients of Atika Capital, with both Atika and Farber sharing voting and dispositive power over these shares. The filing, a SCHEDULE 13G, indicates that no single advisory client beneficially owns more than 5% individually.

articles.headline: Atika Capital (JATT) discloses 5.1% beneficial stake in JATT II Acquisition Corp.

events.title: Oak Harvest Investment Services Buys New Position in Teradyne, Inc. $TER
events.summary: Oak Harvest Investment Services has acquired a new position in Teradyne, Inc. (NASDAQ:TER) during the second quarter, purchasing 13,684 shares valued at approximately $6.6 million. Teradyne has a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts, with an average price target of $396.80. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings, beating EPS and revenue estimates, though insiders have sold $2.27 million of stock over the last quarter.

articles.headline: Oak Harvest Investment Services Buys New Position in Teradyne, Inc. $TER

events.title: TD Waterhouse Canada Inc. Raises Position in Johnson Controls International plc $JCI
events.summary: TD Waterhouse Canada Inc. significantly increased its stake in Johnson Controls International (JCI) by 18% in the second quarter of 2026, bringing its total holdings to 124,880 shares valued at $18.1 million. This move aligns with a generally positive outlook from analysts, who rate JCI a "Moderate Buy" with an average price target of $154.80. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings, beating revenue and EPS estimates, and pays a quarterly dividend of $0.40 per share.

articles.headline: TD Waterhouse Canada Inc. Raises Position in Johnson Controls International plc $JCI

events.title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Seagate Technology and NVIDIA
events.summary: This Zacks Analyst Blog highlights Seagate Technology (STX) and NVIDIA (NVDA), focusing on Seagate's unexpected strong performance driven by AI-driven data storage demand. Seagate's shares have significantly outperformed NVIDIA's this year due to increased demand for high-capacity HDDs, leading to substantial revenue growth and margin expansion. The company's strong financial health and positive outlook make it a compelling investment in the AI infrastructure boom.

articles.headline: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Seagate Technology and NVIDIA

events.title: Nations Financial Group Inc. IA ADV Acquires Shares of 5,223 Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. $TTWO
events.summary: Nations Financial Group Inc. IA ADV has acquired 5,223 shares of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ:TTWO) valued at approximately $1.3 million during the second quarter. Despite missing EPS estimates, Take-Two reported strong revenue, and analysts maintain a "Buy" rating with an average price target of $296.95. However, CEO Strauss Zelnick and President Karl Slatoff recently sold significant shares under pre-arranged trading plans.

articles.headline: Nations Financial Group Inc. IA ADV Acquires Shares of 5,223 Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. $TTWO

events.title: Chevron president, new energies, Jeff Gustavson sells $2.7m in stock
events.summary: Jeff B. Gustavson, President, New Energies at Chevron Corp., sold 14,044 shares of common stock for $2.7 million on August 11, 2026, while also acquiring the same number of shares through stock option exercises valued at $1.66 million. Following these transactions, Gustavson directly holds 3,786 Chevron shares, in addition to indirect holdings and dividend reinvestments. Chevron also reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, leading Mizuho to reiterate an Outperform rating, and maintained dividend payments for 56 consecutive years.

events.title: Databricks' Electric acquisition adds embeddable PostgreSQL
events.summary: Databricks has acquired ElectricSQL to enhance its PostgreSQL database capabilities, extending them to edge devices for AI applications and mobile use. This acquisition builds on Databricks' previous purchase of Neon and aims to enable AI agents to self-correct more efficiently by having embeddable PostgreSQL data locally available. Analysts view this as a strategic move to address critical infrastructure gaps in agentic AI development and differentiate Databricks in a competitive market.

articles.headline: Databricks' Electric acquisition adds embeddable PostgreSQL
